Journey-level classification across all four reported travel legs (Q429b-Q432b block). 141 people report 'do not pay' on every administered leg (numeric zero fare). 2254 journeys are fully costed positive (every administered leg resolves to a known value -- zero or numeric -- with at least one positive). 2 journeys are partially observed positive: at least one leg carries a numeric positive cost but at least one other administered leg is ambiguous/unspecified, so the journey is known to involve real payment but its total is not fully observed. Of the 2256 usable-numeric journeys, 2238 have a numeric FIRST-leg cost alone; 18 were reported free on leg 1 but paid on a later leg and were wrongly zeroed out by a leg-1-only reading. 7 journeys have no positive leg but at least one unresolvable (unspecified-cost or internal-inconsistency) leg. 4 report 'do not know' as the payment period on every administered leg.

Base case (Scenario A for the disputed driver codes): 2165 of 4655 (46.5%) legitimate zero fares; 2394 of 4655 (51.4%) have at least one leg with a usable numeric cost, of which 2392 are fully costed and 2 are partially observed (real payment on at least one leg, total not fully known); 12 of 4655 (0.3%) are ambiguous; 84 of 4655 (1.8%) are confirmed nonresponse under Scenario A.
